items.escena: A sturdy clay strongbox safe with a heavy round padlock on its door; through a small barred window in the door you can glimpse colourful gears inside that nobody can reach

A clay desktop computer monitor on a small desk, its screen showing four overlapping plain coloured rectangles like open windows, a clay keyboard and mouse in front
A clay laptop on a desk with three plain floating sheets hovering above it: a lined text page, a spreadsheet grid and a slide with a simple bar chart
A clay graphics tablet with a stylus pen retouching a portrait photo shown on a clay monitor, small dabs of coloured paint around the stylus tip
A chubby friendly black and white clay penguin with an orange beak sitting beside a small clay computer tower, one flipper resting on it
Clay office documents spread out on a wooden desk around a pencil: a lined text page, a spreadsheet grid sheet and a round pie chart card
A small curled-up orange clay fox with a fluffy tail sitting beside a round clay globe of the Earth with blue oceans and green continents
A clay painting of a hill and sun in a wooden frame, with a small blank ribbon name tag pinned to the corner of the frame and a clay hand pointing at the tag
Two identical clay paintings of a hill and sun in wooden frames standing side by side, both carrying the same small blank ribbon badge on their corner
A clay painting of a hill and sun in a wooden frame next to a large golden clay coin crossed out by a thick red clay bar
A clay painting of a hill and sun sealed inside a closed glass display case, a large golden clay coin crossed out by a thick red clay bar lying beside it
